channel.title: A Merry Tudor Christmas with Lucy Worsley
channel.desc: Lucy Worsley recreates how Christmas was celebrated during the age of Henry VIII, eating, drinking, singing, dancing and partying like people did 500 years ago. She's getting into Tudor clothes, and inside Tudor minds, discovering the forerunners of some of the Christmas customs still enjoyed today, and exploring why other festive traditions fell out of favour.
